skills.name: Heavy swing
skills.text: {attacker} put your weight behind a heavy swing. {target} takes {damage} damage.

attack: {attacker} strike through the pine-dark air. {target} takes {damage} damage.
{attacker} press forward; {target} yields a step, taking {damage} damage.
hurt: A flash of teeth. {attacker} deals {damage} damage to {target}.
narrative.victory: {target} falls still. In the branches above, a bird ventures one uncertain note.
narrative.death:
The trees close over the last of the light. Somewhere beyond them, a bell begins to ring.
Your journey has ended. Start a new game to try again.
